items.title: Claude Code leaking secrets via Don't Ask Again feature
facts: Agentic security firm Apiiro found that Claude Code has been exposing secrets in public repositories due to how it stores them in local file on developers' machines to implement the "Don't Ask Again" feature.
The company identified 1,122 secrets in claude/settings.local.json files and another 1,160 in git history, in the shared settings.json, and in agent chat transcripts stored in repos.
Overall 63 organizations were affected, with exposed secrets including cloud API keys, production passwords and access tokens, and npm tokens.

items.title: Measured latency and accuracy comparison of Claude Code vs Codex
facts: As of 2026-11-22 20:38 UTC, median time to answer the same fixed task, end to end, over the last 24 hours — Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5: 15.5 s (24 runs); Codex CLI with GPT-6 Luna: 20.6 s (24 runs).
On the 78 hard questions both answered in the last 7 days, Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 got 64% right and Codex CLI with GPT-6 Luna 42%.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.330 adds organization sign-in and easel charts
facts: Added sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after claude auth login, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway.
Added easel, a built-in mod that draws charts when asked and under MCP metrics results, on Pro, Max and, where available, Team and Enterprise on macOS and Linux.

items.title: Users report Antigravity 2.7.0 in good state with fixed bugs
facts: Antigravity now has many good updates and less bugs related to development. Most of the issues I have been facing is been fixed.
Repeated file reading is gone. Precision of file changes is higher. There are now swarms you have use to get things done quickly.

items.title: Open source agent ops stack built around Claude Code
facts: Claude Code on a $100 Max seat. All 10 wrap around it, open source, one job each: run. team. loop. guard. bench.
Examples include codex for running a coding agent, harnessrouter for routing to 31 harness bases, and failproofai to block bad tool calls.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows allow Markdown-defined coding agent automations
facts: GitHub can now run coding agents from a Markdown file. Describe triage new issues or analyze failed CI in plain English → Agentic Workflows turns it into GitHub Actions.
Open source, generally available. Your repo can do its own maintenance.

items.title: Developers report code quality issues and regressions with Codex and Claude
facts: I've been running into code problems ever since Codex 5.3. At my day job, these models have consistently introduced regressions that couldn't be merged into production.
On top of that, they get stuck in infinite loops, hit a wall, and suffer from tunnel vision. Claude has plenty of problems too.

items.title: forgerun update enables local agent orchestration for coding agents
facts: forgerun update: coding agents on your own machines, now. Prime Agent joins Claude Code, Cursor CLI, OpenCode & pi.
forgerun MCP → any agent can be the orchestrator (start threads, approve plans, read diffs, follow up & push — local agent drives, work runs in sandboxes).
